messages:
Aisha Patel: Sharing the VoxPulse onboarding feedback dump — ~18 short notes. Can we quick-scan and tag high-risk items for renewals + 3 quick wins? https://redwood.internal/notes/voxpulse :link:
Miguel Torres: on it. do we have the CSV or raw notes?
Aisha Patel: pasted a compressed sample below 
```
1) 'embeddings drift after 7 days, search quality drops' -- wants auto re-index
2) 'setup docs assume default routes, our per-route billing confused us' -- onboarding blocker
3) 'UI for quota alerts not visible' -- led to surprise bill
4) 'latency spikes when batch >8' -- performance ask
```
Lina Chen: thanks. quick grouping: 1 & 4 = runtime/perf, 2 = docs/billing UX, 3 = alerts/notifications.
Samir Rao: anything obviously urgent for renewal risk? item 3 (surprise bill) is highest. call it P0 for CS->PM. :exclamation:
Miguel Torres: I agree, surprise billing hits renewals. Also embeddings drift could be a short-term mitigation with a doc + autoscript, put as quickwin.
Aisha Patel: Proposed tags: [renewal-risk], [quick-win], [requires-engineering]. I'll tag and write short notes. Anyone object? :eyes:
Lina Chen: no objection. For embeddings drift we can suggest: add a scheduled re-index recipe + TTL in SDK. I'll draft.
Miguel Torres: If Lina can draft a small recipe we can ship it as a docs + support playbook this week. I'll add to the PM backlog as 'docs-mitigation for embeddings drift' and set priority P2.
Samir Rao: For billing confusion, suggest adding a per-route example and a toggle screenshot in onboarding flow. That's a P1 for product + CS enablement.
Aisha Patel: Great. Action items:
- Aisha: tag notes in Notion and push top5 to PM board (due EOD)
- Lina: draft re-index recipe & sample code (due Thu)
- Miguel: create PM ticket for billing UX + add to next sprint planning
- Samir: draft a one-pager for CSM playbook about alerting/surprise bill
cs-bot: summary created and attached to thread: SummaryID=vox-1767778888, 18 items parsed, 4 grouped.
Miguel Torres: acked. I can take billing UX ticket owner if needed.
Lina Chen: quick question — any customers using our prebuilt autoscaler? might affect latency notes.
Aisha Patel: two customers on prebuilt autoscaler; I'll mark those rows so eng can correlate.
Samir Rao: thanks team. I'll flag the renewal-risk items on accounts with renewals in next 90 days. :white_check_mark:
Aisha Patel: Perfect. I'll post updates once Notion tags are done. Thanks everyone.
